title: Instant question compiler, hemisphere precision, and quick questions
body:
INSTANT QUESTION COMPILER
- Over 65 common geography question patterns in English and Polish are now compiled instantly in-memory without waiting for AI models.
- Colloquial phrases, shortcuts, and metric comparisons respond within a fraction of a millisecond.
- Persistent two-tier plan cache (in-memory LRU + local SQLite) preserves verified plans across server restarts.

ACCURATE HEMISPHERES & BOUNDING BOXES
- Added high-resolution geographic bounding boxes and multi-hemisphere coverage for all 196 countries.
- Accurately answers questions about countries spanning multiple hemispheres (such as Kiribati in all four hemispheres, or Portugal with the Azores).
- Precise distinction between whether a country touches a hemisphere and whether it lies entirely within it.

QUICK STARTER QUESTIONS
- Added a row of quick question chips above the deduction input: Europe, Coastline, Monarchy, Left-hand drive, European Union, and Island.
- Tap any chip to immediately populate your question input in your selected language.

DATABASE EFFICIENCY UNDER LOAD
- Database read sessions are now committed and released before invoking external models, preventing connection pool starvation during busy daily puzzle windows.
